locator.name: the message box and the tray's space > reports the box's own left and width beside Paseo's sidebar and terminal, and posts again when only they change

proves.facet: In a split layout the posted rectangle carries the box's own left and width, and a width change alone posts again.

locator.name: chat text picks inside the frame > names the agent from the stored focus in the compact layout; a user message, a tool call and a message far back each go with their own time

proves.facet: Fixture chat picks use the stored compact-layout focus and each picked user/tool/old row’s own timestamp; no timeline read supplies provenance.

locator.name: the message box and the tray's space > reserves the tray's height on the chat's scroll root alone, in a split layout

proves.facet: The reserved height pads the chat's scroll root alone - not the sidebar, the terminal pane or the page body - and is released at zero.

locator.name: chat text picks inside the frame > gives one named notice and no offer when a Paseo update leaves the rows' own records unreadable

proves.facet: Unreadable fixture row records emit one named notice and create no offer or pick during that channel lifetime.

locator.name: chat text picks inside the frame > offers ⊕ add on highlighted chat text and posts its pick with agent, message and the row's own time, keeping selection and focus

proves.facet: The fixture offer posts the selected text, agent, message ID and recorded row time, while offer mousedown/click preserves the selected range and focused element.

locator.name: the message box and the tray's space > reports the box's new position when the layout moves it without resizing it

proves.facet: A container resize and a class change that resizes nothing each post the box's new left; an identical rectangle posts nothing.

locator.name: chat text picks inside the frame > refuses by name, in place, text of a message the host has not recorded yet: no pick goes without its time

proves.facet: An untimed recorded-row offer changes to the named refusal and posts no pick; a later recorded timestamp allows the selected row to be picked.
